${A}_{△}=${{field-1}}" :question/worked-solution "Using the formula, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}p\times q & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -3 & 6 & 0 \\ 4 & 3 & -6\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}6 & 0 \\ 3 & -6\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 \\ 4 & -6\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}-3 & 6 \\ 4 & 3\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(6\cdot (-6)-0\cdot 3)i-((-3)\cdot (-6)-0\cdot 4)j+((-3)\cdot 3-6\cdot 4)k \\  & =-36i-18j-33k \\  & =⟨-36,-18,-33⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of the corresponding parallelogram is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =|\,p\times q\,| \\  & =\sqrt{(-36)^{2}+(-18)^{2}+(-33)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1296+324+1089} \\  & =\sqrt{2709} \\  & =3\sqrt{301}.\end{aligned}
$$

The area of the triangle is half of the area of the respective parallelogram. So, the area of the triangle is

$$
{A}_{△}=\frac{1}{2}A=\frac{3\sqrt{301}}{2}.
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate :question/answer-fields ["4255caa3-50ba-54fa-82a8-74962672c0b3"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "4cdff164-9c10-5307-b70c-2f04f4e1f669" :answer/id #uuid "4cdff164-9c10-5307-b70c-2f04f4e1f669" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3\sqrt{35}}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "58acee81-163c-5d99-be85-835f8c840a02" :answer/id #uuid "58acee81-163c-5d99-be85-835f8c840a02" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3\sqrt{10}}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "986ee716-53e1-5587-be39-666b7583b953" :answer/id #uuid "986ee716-53e1-5587-be39-666b7583b953" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3\sqrt{35}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "9b125b61-7430-5b72-b48d-059cde3e3973" :answer/id #uuid "9b125b61-7430-5b72-b48d-059cde3e3973" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3\sqrt{26}}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "599f2164-d778-5b3f-958c-c13692e24761" :answer/id #uuid "599f2164-d778-5b3f-958c-c13692e24761" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\frac{3\sqrt{34}}{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "dc7e8718-61f5-5615-94c6-2b4a3db6804f" :answer-field/id #uuid "dc7e8718-61f5-5615-94c6-2b4a3db6804f" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["4cdff164-9c10-5307-b70c-2f04f4e1f669" "58acee81-163c-5d99-be85-835f8c840a02" "986ee716-53e1-5587-be39-666b7583b953" "9b125b61-7430-5b72-b48d-059cde3e3973" "599f2164-d778-5b3f-958c-c13692e24761"] :answer-field/correct "4cdff164-9c10-5307-b70c-2f04f4e1f669" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "ff6ee37a-5df7-5240-8139-6d8ab72c6503" :question/id #uuid "ff6ee37a-5df7-5240-8139-6d8ab72c6503" :question/problem "Calculate the area of the triangle spanned by $r=⟨5,-5,-4⟩$ and $t=⟨2,1,-1⟩.$" :question/worked-solution "Using the formula, we have
